# Synthetic governed-filter native DTOs

`governed-filter-native.json` is an unchanged JSON export of public request and
response types exercised by `TestReportAppAuthoringOptions` in
`test/acceptance/report_app_options_test.go`. It was captured on 2026-10-04 from
an isolated real PostgreSQL/native source fixture, with race detection enabled.

## Provenance

- Capture source commit: `eb678cfa7c9f852e26c20817917eefe76f378a77`
  (built on `cd01cd6f549c6bf65c8f7222a866ce03398fb83a`).
- Command: `CHARTWORKS_FILTER_DTO_PATH=/tmp/governed-filter-native.json go test -race ./test/acceptance -run '^TestReportAppAuthoringOptions$' -count=1 -v`.
  Configure the repository's documented isolated PostgreSQL/native test runtime
  first; no database connection information belongs in this fixture.
- Final native result: PASS; test 23.80 seconds, package 24.958 seconds.
- Recording size: 341,936 bytes (maximum 512 KiB).
- SHA-256: `721737273c4ee6f2e7ec06b462408016cf353ba0ed16fa2499e788c378e756c6`.

The source fixture constructs literal synthetic sales rows and reviewed Day and
Region dimensions. All identity, source, dataset, context, topic, report, block,
operation and run coordinates are synthetic. Dynamic identifiers, timestamps,
evidence and digests are generated by the native services. No retained result
has been relabeled to match a browser scenario.

The exporter recursively rejects SQL/statements, native attempts/control records,
credentials, tokens, sessions, authorization, passwords and DSNs, then enforces
the 512 KiB limit before writing. Its exported public metadata intentionally
retains exact resource/context pins and ordinary evidence digests. It excludes
verified identity envelopes and source execution internals.

## Continuous contract

- `initial_report` / `initial_drafts`: private report revision 1, Analysis and
  Notes pages. Analysis defaults are Region `[North, South]` and date range
  `2026-01-01` through exclusive `2026-02-01`.
- `save_request` / `saved_state` / `private_report` / `saved_drafts`: actual CAS
  Save and reopen at private revision 2. New defaults are Region `[North, East]`
  and `2026-01-02` through exclusive `2026-02-01`. Save preserves user selection
  order and the entire Notes page.
- `initial_option_*`, `private_option_*`, `published_option_*`: real explicit
  Region Search requests and responses for each exact report revision, digest,
  page, filter and private/published policy. Search is `East`, limit 199.
- `validation_request` / `validation` / `validated_block`: separate explicit
  source validation and safe block-read evidence at the same block revision.
- `private_runs`: native admission, execution and retained views for defaults,
  temporary selections and cleared selections. Each has a root, chart output
  and sibling Notes text request/response.
- `published_report` / `published_description` / `published_catalog`: published
  report revision 5. Two exact references to the same block preserve the native
  mixed-reference regression and deduplicate to one source execution per run.
- `published_runs`: native run requests/responses, root and Notes views, and
  chart-output request/response maps keyed by widget ID for the same three
  selection cases.
- `private_after_runs` / `published_after_runs`: authoritative unchanged reads
  proving runtime selections and clearing did not rewrite saved definitions.

The temporary request is Region `[North]` with date range `2026-01-01` through
exclusive `2026-01-02`. Exact retained amounts are `3.250` for saved defaults,
`1.250` for temporary selections, and `3.250` after clearing back to defaults.
Every explicit private/public execution is asserted to make exactly one source
read. Private admission, save/reopen, metadata and retained reads make none;
model calls remain unchanged. The native compiler's block defaults also remain
unchanged independently of the edited report defaults.

`read_counts` summarizes assertions in the native test; browser call-ledger
checks separately establish that local input, Cancel, Done and Clear do not
invoke query tools. Native race tests and recorded browser replays are distinct
qualifications. This fixture does not establish deployed host admission, a real
user's authorization, live browser-to-PostgreSQL connectivity or provider use.

Regenerate to an external output path, inspect the diff and rerun native and
frontend checks before replacing this recording. Never edit captured values,
immutable revisions, run identities or digests to make a replay pass.
